async def act(page):
    """
    From the current New Product (Prices) page, finish creating the product:
      - Set Tax Class to "Taxable Goods" (required field in Prices)
      - Open Inventory tab and set Qty = 42 and Stock Availability = In Stock
      - Open Custom Options and add two drop-down options: Size -> uni-size, Color -> black
      - Save the product (Save is the last action because it navigates away)

    All interactions use accessibility selectors only (.get_by_role, .get_by_label) and
    .select_option for comboboxes. No external knowledge_base functions are available.
    """
    import asyncio

    async def try_click_role(role, names, timeout=1500):
        """Try clicking an element of given role with any of the name substrings in names.
        Returns True on success, False otherwise."""
        for name in names:
            try:
                el = page.get_by_role(role, name=name).first
                await el.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=timeout)
                await el.click()
                return True
            except Exception:
                continue
        return False

    async def try_select_combobox(names, option_label, timeout=1500):
        """Try selecting option_label in a combobox that matches any name in names.
        Fallback: try any combobox on the page."""
        for name in names:
            try:
                cb = page.get_by_role("combobox", name=name).first
                await cb.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=timeout)
                # prefer selecting by label
                await cb.select_option(label=option_label)
                return True
            except Exception:
                continue
        # fallback to any combobox
        try:
            cb_any = page.get_by_role("combobox").first
            await cb_any.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=timeout)
            await cb_any.select_option(label=option_label)
            return True
        except Exception:
            return False

    async def try_fill_by_label(label_names, value, start_index=0, timeout=1200):
        """Try filling a textbox/input identified by any label in label_names.
        If multiple inputs exist with same label, search starting at start_index.
        Returns True if filled."""
        for lbl in label_names:
            # try several indices to account for multiple identical labels
            for idx in range(start_index, start_index + 8):
                try:
                    inp = page.get_by_label(lbl).nth(idx)
                    await inp.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=timeout)
                    await inp.fill(value)
                    return True
                except Exception:
                    continue
        return False

    # Give UI a short moment to stabilize
    await asyncio.sleep(0.4)

    # 1) Set Tax Class in Prices (required)
    await try_select_combobox(["Tax Class *", "Tax Class"], "Taxable Goods")
    await asyncio.sleep(0.2)

    # 2) Inventory: click Inventory link in left nav and set Qty and Stock Availability
    await try_click_role("link", ["Inventory"])  # substring match
    # allow inventory panel to load
    await asyncio.sleep(0.6)
    # Qty label variants
    await try_fill_by_label(["Qty", "Qty *", "Quantity", "Quantity *"], "42")
    # Stock Availability combobox
    await try_select_combobox(["Stock Availability", "Stock Availability *", "Stock Status"], "In Stock")
    await asyncio.sleep(0.2)

    # 3) Custom Options: add Size -> uni-size and Color -> black
    await try_click_role("link", ["Custom Options"])  # substring match
    await asyncio.sleep(0.5)

    async def add_custom_dropdown_option(option_title, option_value):
        # Click Add New Option (common label)
        added = await try_click_role("button", ["Add New Option", "Add New", "Add Option"]) 
        if not added:
            return False
        await asyncio.sleep(0.3)

        # Fill the newly added option Title. Search for a Title input that is empty and fill it.
        filled_title = False
        for idx in range(0, 8):
            try:
                title_input = page.get_by_label("Title").nth(idx)
                await title_input.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=800)
                try:
                    current = await title_input.input_value()
                except Exception:
                    current = ""
                if (not current) or current.strip() == "":
                    await title_input.fill(option_title)
                    filled_title = True
                    break
            except Exception:
                continue

        # Set type to Drop-down
        await try_select_combobox(["Input Type", "Type"], "Drop-down")

        # Add a value row for the option
        await try_click_role("button", ["Add New Row", "Add Row", "Add Value"]) 
        await asyncio.sleep(0.25)

        # Fill the value Title (find a Title input that does not contain the option title)
        filled_value = False
        for idx in range(0, 12):
            try:
                val_input = page.get_by_label("Title").nth(idx)
                await val_input.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=600)
                try:
                    cur = await val_input.input_value()
                except Exception:
                    cur = ""
                # skip the option's own Title input
                if option_title.lower() in (cur or "").lower():
                    continue
                if (not cur) or cur.strip() == "":
                    await val_input.fill(option_value)
                    filled_value = True
                    break
            except Exception:
                continue

        return filled_title and filled_value

    # add Size option
    await add_custom_dropdown_option("Size", "uni-size")
    await asyncio.sleep(0.2)
    # add Color option
    await add_custom_dropdown_option("Color", "black")
    await asyncio.sleep(0.2)

    # 4) Save the product (last action)
    try:
        await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save").first.click()
    except Exception:
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save and Continue Edit").first.click()
        except Exception:
            # last resort: click the first visible button (conservative)
            try:
                await page.get_by_role("button").first.click()
            except Exception:
                pass

    # allow navigation/save to complete
    await asyncio.sleep(1)

            except Exception:
                continue
        return False

    async def try_select_combobox(names, option_label, timeout=1500):
        """Try selecting option_label in a combobox that matches any name in names.
        Fallback: try any combobox on the page."""
        for name in names:
            try:
                cb = page.get_by_role("combobox", name=name).first
                await cb.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=timeout)
                # prefer selecting by label
                await cb.select_option(label=option_label)
                return True
            except Exception:
                continue
        # fallback to any combobox
        try:
            cb_any = page.get_by_role("combobox").first
            await cb_any.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=timeout)
            await cb_any.select_option(label=option_label)
            return True
        except Exception:
            return False

    async def try_fill_by_label(label_names, value, start_index=0, timeout=1200):
        """Try filling a textbox/input identified by any label in label_names.
        If multiple inputs exist with same label, search starting at start_index.
        Returns True if filled."""
        for lbl in label_names:
            # try several indices to account for multiple identical labels
            for idx in range(start_index, start_index + 8):
                try:
                    inp = page.get_by_label(lbl).nth(idx)
                    await inp.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=timeout)
                    await inp.fill(value)
                    return True
                except Exception:
                    continue
        return False

    # Give UI a short moment to stabilize
    await asyncio.sleep(0.4)

    # 1) Set Tax Class in Prices (required)
    await try_select_combobox(["Tax Class *", "Tax Class"], "Taxable Goods")
    await asyncio.sleep(0.2)

    # 2) Inventory: click Inventory link in left nav and set Qty and Stock Availability
    await try_click_role("link", ["Inventory"])  # substring match
    # allow inventory panel to load
    await asyncio.sleep(0.6)
    # Qty label variants
    await try_fill_by_label(["Qty", "Qty *", "Quantity", "Quantity *"], "42")
    # Stock Availability combobox
    await try_select_combobox(["Stock Availability", "Stock Availability *", "Stock Status"], "In Stock")
    await asyncio.sleep(0.2)

    # 3) Custom Options: add Size -> uni-size and Color -> black
    await try_click_role("link", ["Custom Options"])  # substring match
    await asyncio.sleep(0.5)

    async def add_custom_dropdown_option(option_title, option_value):
        # Click Add New Option (common label)
        added = await try_click_role("button", ["Add New Option", "Add New", "Add Option"])
        if not added:
            return False
        await asyncio.sleep(0.3)

        # Fill the newly added option Title. Search for a Title input that is empty and fill it.
        filled_title = False
        for idx in range(0, 8):
            try:
                title_input = page.get_by_label("Title").nth(idx)
                await title_input.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=800)
                try:
                    current = await title_input.input_value()
                except Exception:
                    current = ""
                if (not current) or current.strip() == "":
                    await title_input.fill(option_title)
                    filled_title = True
                    break
            except Exception:
                continue

        # Set type to Drop-down
        await try_select_combobox(["Input Type", "Type"], "Drop-down")

        # Add a value row for the option
        await try_click_role("button", ["Add New Row", "Add Row", "Add Value"])
        await asyncio.sleep(0.25)

        # Fill the value Title (find a Title input that does not contain the option title)
        filled_value = False
        for idx in range(0, 12):
            try:
                val_input = page.get_by_label("Title").nth(idx)
                await val_input.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=600)
                try:
                    cur = await val_input.input_value()
                except Exception:
                    cur = ""
                # skip the option's own Title input
                if option_title.lower() in (cur or "").lower():
                    continue
                if (not cur) or cur.strip() == "":
                    await val_input.fill(option_value)
                    filled_value = True
                    break
            except Exception:
                continue

        return filled_title and filled_value

    # add Size option
    await add_custom_dropdown_option("Size", "uni-size")
    await asyncio.sleep(0.2)
    # add Color option
    await add_custom_dropdown_option("Color", "black")
    await asyncio.sleep(0.2)

    # 4) Save the product (last action)
    try:
        await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save").first.click()
    except Exception:
        try:
            await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save and Continue Edit").first.click()
        except Exception:
            # last resort: click the first visible button (conservative)
            try:
                await page.get_by_role("button").first.click()
            except Exception:
                pass

    # allow navigation/save to complete
    await asyncio.sleep(1)
